scenes.text: Imagine being the only tree for two hundred and fifty miles in every direction.
For decades, it served as a living landmark for desert travelers, a miracle of survival with roots reaching over a hundred feet deep to find water.
But in 1973, a supposedly drunk driver managed to drive across hundreds of miles of flat desert and crash directly into this single tree, knocking it down.
Today, a metal monument stands where it once grew, reminding us of the ultimate cosmic irony, so would you have believed this actually happened?
